contentFull:
Africa's premier agricultural stage returns bigger, bolder and more connected than ever

The Africa Agri Expo will celebrate its 10th edition when it returns to Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania, on 2-3 September 2026. Building on 9 previous editions that have brought together farmers, agribusiness leaders, investors, policymakers and innovators from around the world, this year's Jubilee edition will be the largest yet.

Jul 28

Partner

The Africa Agri Expo will take place in Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania, from 2-3 September 2026. Photos: TAB Global 

Co-located with the 3rd Future Food Livestock & Poultry Expo, the event will bring together the full agricultural value chain under one roof, creating a platform for trade, innovation and investment across crop production, livestock, food processing and agri-technology.

This is not a regional event with regional ambitions. It is a global platform anchored in the world’s most exciting agricultural frontier – and it is coming at exactly the right moment.

Why Africa – and why now?

The African continent holds over 60% of the world’s uncultivated arable land, is home to a rapidly expanding middle class, and represents one of the fastest-growing food markets on the planet. With a population projected to double by 2050, African agriculture is not just a development story – it is a global business opportunity of historic proportions. Companies that establish a foothold here today are positioning themselves for decades of growth that few other markets can offer.

Tanzania, in particular, is emerging as one of East Africa’s most dynamic agricultural economies. With fertile land, a strategic coastal location, and a government actively investing in agri-infrastructure, Dar-es-Salaam serves as a natural gateway for businesses looking to enter or expand across East and Central Africa. The city’s port connectivity, improving logistics networks, and growing commercial ecosystem, make it ideal for forging distribution partnerships, scouting suppliers, and launching new products into one of the continent’s most promising markets.

“Africa is not the market of the future – it is the market of today. The businesses that build relationships here now will lead the next decade of global agri-food trade.” — Tahir Abdul Bari, CEO, TAB Group 

What to expect

The Africa Agri Expo is built to deliver genuine business value – not just a trade floor, but a living ecosystem of deals, dialogue, and discovery. Over 2 full days, exhibitors and attendees have access to live product demonstrations and launches spanning crop production, smart farming, irrigation systems, post-harvest technology, agri-inputs, machinery, and digital agriculture tools. The expo floor is where manufacturers meet buyers, where technology meets adoption, and where new market relationships are born.

Through the co-located Future Food Livestock & Poultry Expo, a dedicated zone covers animal nutrition, veterinary solutions, breeding technologies, cold chain infrastructure, and processing equipment – making this one of the very few events in Africa where agri and food-livestock businesses can engage a shared, crossover audience under one roof.

High-level conference sessions and panel discussions bring together industry experts, government representatives, and thought leaders to address the defining issues of African agriculture today: climate-smart farming, food security, agri-finance, and the role of youth in building the continent’s agricultural future. 

Grow your business – exhibit, sponsor, or speak

The Africa Agri Expo 2026 offers every business a meaningful way to participate. Exhibitors gain direct access to thousands of qualified buyers, importers, and distributors, with dedicated demonstration space to showcase products and generate on-floor leads. For companies looking to enter new African markets or deepen existing relationships, there is no more efficient platform on the continent. 

Sponsorship packages place your brand at the very centre of the event – from the opening ceremony to conference sessions and networking breaks. Premium visibility across all event touchpoints, logo placement on signage, lanyards, and digital screens, and complimentary delegate passes make sponsorship a powerful brand investment that reaches a senior, decision-making audience precisely when they are evaluating solutions and suppliers. 

For organisations looking to lead the conversation, speaking opportunities during the conference programme offer the chance to present research, share insights, or facilitate panel discussions, establishing thought leadership, driving media coverage, and building stakeholder relationships that extend well beyond the event itself. Whichever path you choose, your association with Africa’s premier agricultural expo is a strategic entry point into one of the world’s fastest-growing agri-food economies. 

Marking a decade of impact

Reaching the 10th edition is no small milestone. Over the past decade, the Africa Agri Expo has helped thousands of businesses forge meaningful connections, facilitated significant trade deals, and played a meaningful role in raising the profile of African agriculture on the world stage. The 2026 edition is both a celebration of that journey and a confident step into the next chapter – with a broader audience, a larger exhibition floor, and the added reach of the Future Food Livestock & Poultry Expo making this the most compelling edition yet.

Register. Exhibit. Sponsor. Partner.

Be part of Africa’s most important agricultural business event of 2026. Whether you are an exhibitor ready to showcase your solutions, a sponsor looking to lead the conversation, a speaker with insights to share, or a delegate looking to source, network, and learn – your seat at the table is waiting. Secure your participation today and take your place at the heart of African agribusiness.

Ready to be part of Africa Agri Expo 2026?

Whether you want to exhibit, sponsor, speak or attend, now is the time to secure your place at the Africa Agri Expo, Africa's leading agricultural business event. For exhibition, sponsorship and partnership enquiries, email agri.expo@tab-global.com.
translationZh:
非洲首屈一指的农业舞台将以更大规模、更大胆的姿态和更紧密的联系回归。

非洲农业博览会将于2026年9月2日至3日重返坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆，庆祝其第十届盛会。在前九届成功汇聚全球农民、农业企业领袖、投资者、政策制定者和创新者的基础上，今年的金禧纪念版将成为迄今规模最大的一届。

与第三届未来食品畜牧与家禽博览会同期举办，该活动将把农业全价值链汇聚一堂，为作物生产、畜牧、食品加工和农业技术领域的贸易、创新和投资打造一个平台。

这不是一场只有区域雄心的区域性活动。这是一个扎根于世界上最激动人心的农业前沿的全球平台——而且恰逢其时。

**为什么是非洲——为什么是现在？**

非洲大陆拥有全球超过60%的未开垦耕地，中产阶级迅速壮大，是全球增长最快的食品市场之一。预计到2050年人口将翻一番，非洲农业不仅仅是一个发展故事——它是一个具有历史意义的全球商业机遇。今天在此立足的企业，将为自己在未来几十年内赢得其他市场难以提供的增长空间。

尤其是坦桑尼亚，正崛起为东非最具活力的农业经济体之一。凭借肥沃的土地、战略性的沿海位置以及积极投资农业基础设施的政府，达累斯萨拉姆成为企业进入或扩展至东非和中非市场的天然门户。该市的港口连通性、不断改善的物流网络以及日益增长的商业生态系统，使其成为建立分销伙伴关系、寻找供应商以及将新产品推向非洲大陆最有前景市场之一的理想之地。

“非洲不是未来的市场——它是今天的市场。现在在这里建立关系的企业将引领未来十年的全球农产品贸易。”——Tahir Abdul Bari，TAB集团首席执行官

**值得期待的内容**

非洲农业博览会旨在提供真正的商业价值——不仅仅是一个贸易展位，而是一个充满交易、对话和发现的活生态系统。在整整两天的时间里，参展商和观众可以参与涵盖作物生产、智慧农业、灌溉系统、采后技术、农业投入品、机械和数字农业工具的现场产品演示和发布。展馆是制造商与买家相遇、技术与应用相遇、新市场关系诞生的地方。

通过同期举办的未来食品畜牧与家禽博览会，一个专门区域将涵盖动物营养、兽医解决方案、育种技术、冷链基础设施和加工设备——这使其成为非洲为数不多的、农业和食品畜牧企业可以在同一屋檐下接触共享跨界观众的展会之一。

高层会议和小组讨论将汇集行业专家、政府代表和思想领袖，共同探讨当今非洲农业的关键议题：气候智慧型农业、粮食安全、农业金融以及青年在建设非洲农业未来中的作用。

**发展您的业务——参展、赞助或演讲**

2026年非洲农业博览会为每家企业提供了有意义的参与方式。参展商可以直接接触数千名合格买家、进口商和分销商，并拥有专门的演示空间来展示产品并在展位上产生销售线索。对于希望进入新非洲市场或深化现有关系的企业来说，这是非洲大陆上最高效的平台。

赞助套餐将您的品牌置于活动的核心——从开幕式到会议和茶歇。在所有活动接触点上的高级可见性、标识、挂绳和数字屏幕上的标志展示，以及免费的参会代表通行证，使赞助成为一项强大的品牌投资，能够在决策者评估解决方案和供应商时触达高层决策受众。

对于希望引领对话的组织来说，会议期间的演讲机会提供了展示研究、分享见解或主持小组讨论的机会，从而建立思想领导力、推动媒体报道并建立超越活动本身的利益相关者关系。无论您选择哪条路径，与非洲首屈一指的农业博览会的联系都是进入全球增长最快的农产品经济体之一的战略切入点。

**纪念十年影响力**

达到第十届是一个重要的里程碑。在过去十年中，非洲农业博览会帮助数千家企业建立了有意义的联系，促成了大量贸易交易，并在提升非洲农业在世界舞台上的形象方面发挥了重要作用。2026年的展会既是对这一历程的庆祝，也是迈向下一篇章的自信一步——更广泛的观众、更大的展览面积，以及未来食品畜牧与家禽博览会的加入，使其成为迄今最具吸引力的展会。

**注册。参展。赞助。合作。**

成为2026年非洲最重要的农业商业活动的一部分。无论您是准备展示解决方案的参展商、希望引领对话的赞助商、有见解要分享的演讲者，还是希望采购、交流和学习的代表——您的席位正在等待。立即确保您的参与，在非洲农业企业的核心占据一席之地。

准备好参与2026年非洲农业博览会了吗？

无论您想参展、赞助、演讲还是参会，现在是时候确保您在非洲领先农业商业活动——非洲农业博览会中的席位了。如需展览、赞助和合作咨询，请发送邮件至agri.expo@tab-global.com。
